journal_lines: §lPhantom§l from above. Watched for the shadow on the ground. Got the timing.
§cDive caught my back. §oWing felt like a plank.§o Came home sore.
Screech overhead. Moved sideways. Got clear.
Two of them. Took the lower one first. Then waited on the second.
§oMakes a sound like canvas tearing before it dives.§o Learned that on the first pass.
Swooped three times before I connected. Patient work.
§lPhantom§l at height, circling. Cast a shadow twice my size. Waited for the dive.
§cClipped my ear on the second pass. §oFast.§o Timed the third one better.
Fell light when it came down. Lighter than it looked up there.
§oEyes like two blue gaps in a dark thing.§o Doesn't blink. Neither did I.
Came at me out of a sky I had stopped watching. Won't do that again.
Membrane and hollow bone. Felled it. Kept the feathers.
